ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/light grey) central pixels to low-intensity (black/dark charcoal) peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity zones on both lobes bounded by thick, low-intensity margins. Fine-grained, low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are distributed across the high-intensity regions, with higher density on the medial aspect of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and steep valleys, most pronounced on the distal trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the peduncle transition, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated in the central-light regions of both lobes, suggesting pigmentation or localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent, dark linear pixel disruption on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the upper-central region toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable diagonal linear scar on the right lobe and significant, irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density mottling pattern on the leading edge of the left lobe and a distinct dark-pixel protrusion on the extreme right tip.
